# cubiomes-bedrock Attribution

This directory vendors the Bedrock biome generator sources from the `bedrock`
branch of `https://github.com/reedacartwright/cubiomes`.

Copyright (c) 2020 Cubitect and contributors. The source is used under the
MIT License included in `LICENSE`. ChiyanMap uses this snapshot only through
`src/worldgen/BedrockBiomeValidator.cpp` for deterministic, seed-only Bedrock
1.21 village biome eligibility checks.
